follow-up time: From early pregnancy (12-14 weeks gestation) to late pregnancy (34 weeks gestation)
study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
outcome: Fasting lipid profiles (total cholesterol, triglycerides, low-density lipoproteins)
cohort: 518 pregnant women participating in the ROLO (Randomized cOntrol trial of a LOw glycemic index diet in pregnancy) study
finding: A higher Energy-Adjusted Dietary Inflammatory Index (pro-inflammatory diet) during pregnancy was associated with increased cardiometabolic risk factors, including higher BMI, cholesterol, triglycerides, and blood pressure.
gest_age: Early pregnancy (12-14 weeks) and late pregnancy (34 weeks)
